followUp.rootCause: The three entry tests select the newest case and share the ordinary 60-second CI test/renderer wait budget. They timed out during initial rendering, while the same head passed the full Paint WebGL2 simulation, parameter/reset and continuation assertions on both viewports. No old shader-specific test failed.

adjustment.rationale: The successful desktop Paint test already took about 5.6 of the six allowed minutes, so eight CI minutes provide margin for four 600-step solves and unchanged image checks. Three latest-case entry tests need time for this initialization; their CI waits become three minutes. Local budgets and all comparison conditions remain unchanged.
